title: OS-level sandbox
summary: Enforced by the operating system (macOS Seatbelt, Linux bubblewrap): Bash and every child process cannot read credential directories and can only reach allowlisted domains.
protects: Any process, including Python or Node scripts, reading ~/.ssh, ~/.aws and similar
tradeoffs: Network commands can only reach allowlisted domains (package registries and GitHub by default); ssh to your own servers fails until you add them
If the sandbox cannot start, Claude Code refuses to run instead of silently falling back
A command that fails in the sandbox cannot be retried outside it
cannot: Commands you type yourself after the ! prefix are not sandboxed. Native Windows is not supported; use WSL2.
